regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate current photofragmentation claim. The graphical abstract is a generic R1/R2 transformation and is linked to the current general scheme, not assigned a concrete yield.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a and adjacent Introduction prose
regions.finding: Classified cyclobutanone 1 photolysis at 266 nm to diphenylketene 2 plus phenanthrene as a cited Tippmann/Curtis literature example, not a current-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1b and lower-right precursor-synthesis introduction
regions.finding: Classified 3→4 plus phenanthrene as the current generic reaction class and linked the stated 1/6/8 precursor origins to the detailed Scheme 2/page-3 experiments without duplicating them.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic R groups do not define a unique structure or experiment-specific charge.
The cited prior example omits solvent, time, temperature, and yield in this article.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.finding: Identified three distinct Tebbe olefinations 1→5, 6→7, and 8→9. The diagram is merged with the independent detailed page-3 procedures rather than treated as a generic single reaction.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Scheme 3 and left-column photochemical summary
regions.finding: Identified three distinct analytical photolyses 5→10, 7→11, and 9→12 under 280–400 nm irradiation. The summary gives allene yields 56/74/80%; detailed page 3 gives 57/74/80%, so the 5→10 discrepancy is retained.
Classified dashed 13→14 as a prospective general scheme only; the text says it could potentially occur and reports no experiment.

regions.region: page 2 experimental general information and Figure 1
regions.finding: Recorded general synthetic argon/oven-dried-glassware context, photolysis-monitoring summary, chromatography medium/eluent, and the single-crystal depictions of 5/7/9 as supporting context. Literature-made starting cyclobutanones/authentic allenes were not promoted to current preparations.

unresolved: Source conflict for 5→10 allene yield: 56% in the summary versus 57% in the detailed procedure.
Scheme 4 has no performed experiment or observation.
CCDC identifiers are listed later without an explicit compound-to-number mapping in the inspected text.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left photolysis and X-ray apparatus paragraphs
regions.finding: Recorded the common 200 W Xe(Hg)/280–400 nm/30 cm/ambient-temperature/benzene-d6/5 mm quartz-tube photolysis conditions. The X-ray instrumentation paragraph is characterization context, not a reaction.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left and upper-right precursor procedures
regions.finding: Recorded three independent Tebbe olefinations with every printed charge, concentration, carrier solvent, hold, quench, extraction/wash/drying operation, chromatography, mass, isolated yield, and melting range.

regions.region: page 3 right-column Photolysis of 5, 7, and 9 paragraphs
regions.finding: Recorded three independent analytical photolyses with precursor/internal-standard/solvent charges, 15 min NMR monitoring, exact completion times, allene/phenanthrene NMR yields, authentic-sample and GC-MS identity evidence, and the failed 5/10 isolation due to coelution.
Separated the 20 mg photolysis of 7 and the 50 mg photolysis of 9 from their smaller NMR-scale runs because scale and isolated outcomes differ. The 9 result continues onto page 4.

unresolved: Isolation-scale photolyses do not report solvent volume, exact irradiation time, internal-standard use, or pre-column workup.
The photolysis atmosphere/sealing and lamp photon flux are unreported.
Complex substrate/product structures remain source-labeled and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Photolysis of 9
regions.finding: Completed the existing 50 mg isolation-scale record: precursor 9 (0.148 mmol) affords adamantylideneallene 12 (5 mg, 21%) and phenanthrene (22 mg, 84%) after silica/hexanes chromatography.

regions.region: page 4 Associated Content and Accession Codes
regions.finding: The publisher advertises SI and lists CCDC deposits 2305847, 2328907, and 2430114. Workspace association remains unestablished, and the inspected text does not explicitly map each number to 5/7/9; no SI or compound-code assignment was inferred.
